\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 264-267 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R272-first-pass-words-from-chapters-264-267}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an envoy and a clerk.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item nowhere, from all sides, here and there, upwards, downwards
  \item even as, as, if only, on the contrary, at least
  \item wonderful, different, similar, fair, unjust
  \item fat, clever, special, former, nearest
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Nowhere? (\textbf{nusquam}.) From all sides? (\textbf{undique}.) Here and there? (\textbf{passim}.) Upwards? (\textbf{sūrsum}.) Downwards? (\textbf{deorsum}.) Even as? (\textbf{sīcut}.) As? (\textbf{velut}.) If only? (\textbf{utinam}.) On the contrary? (\textbf{immō}.) At least? (\textbf{saltem}.) Wonderful? (\textbf{mīrus, mīra, mīrum}.) Different? (\textbf{dīversus, dīversa, dīversum}.) Similar? (\textbf{similis, simile}.) Fair? (\textbf{iūstus, iūsta, iūstum}.) Unjust? (\textbf{iniūstus, iniūsta, iniūstum}.) Fat? (\textbf{pinguis, pingue}.) Clever? (\textbf{callidus, callida, callidum}.) Special? (\textbf{praecipuus, praecipua, praecipuum}.) Former? (\textbf{prīstinus, prīstina, prīstinum}.) Nearest? (\textbf{proximus, proxima, proximum}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 268-272 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R272-second-pass-words-from-chapters-268-272}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the second of two and suitable.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the second of two, suitable, fit, ready, facing
  \item gloomy, drunk, sober, greedy, thrifty
  \item a racecourse, a hall of justice, the senate house, an anchor, an oar
  \item a people, a state; citizenship, a homeland, an enemy, war
  \item a butcher, an innkeeper, a banker, an envoy, a clerk
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The second of two? (\textbf{alter, altera, alterum}.) Suitable? (\textbf{idōneus, idōnea, idōneum}.) Fit? (\textbf{aptus, apta, aptum}.) Ready? (\textbf{parātus, parāta, parātum}.) Facing? (\textbf{adversus, adversa, adversum}.) Gloomy? (\textbf{maestus, maesta, maestum}.) Drunk? (\textbf{ēbrius, ēbria, ēbrium}.) Sober? (\textbf{sōbrius, sōbria, sōbrium}.) Greedy? (\textbf{avārus, avāra, avārum}.) Thrifty? (\textbf{parcus, parca, parcum}.) A racecourse? (\textbf{circus, circī}.) A hall of justice? (\textbf{basilica, basilicae}.) The senate house? (\textbf{cūria, cūriae}.) An anchor? (\textbf{ancora, ancorae}.) An oar? (\textbf{rēmus, rēmī}.) A people? (\textbf{populus, populī}.) A state; citizenship? (\textbf{cīvitās, cīvitātis}.) A homeland? (\textbf{patria, patriae}.) An enemy? (\textbf{hostis, hostis}.) War? (\textbf{bellum, bellī}.) A butcher? (\textbf{lanius, laniī}.) An innkeeper? (\textbf{caupō, caupōnis}.) A banker? (\textbf{argentārius, argentāriī}.) An envoy? (\textbf{lēgātus, lēgātī}.) A clerk? (\textbf{scrība, scrībae}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
